label: PMG3000-D20B GPON SFP-type SFU
description: Zyxel PMG3000-D20B Gigabit GPON SFU built into an SFP electrical footprint: one SC/APC ITU-T G.984 GPON port and an MSA SFP host edge connector that bridges GPON to a router or switch cage, with no RJ45 of its own. Managed over OMCI (G.984.4 / TR-247).
